newsitem.title: USA: PARKER DRILLING CLOSES BOLIFOR ACQUISITION.
newsitem.headline: PARKER DRILLING CLOSES BOLIFOR ACQUISITION.

text.p: Parker Drilling Co said Thursday that it has closed the acquisition of the drilling-related assets of Bolivia's largest privately owned drilling contractor, Bolifor SA.
The acquisition, said Parker, includes eleven drilling and workover rigs located in Bolivia, Paraguay and Argentina, and associated equipment and facilities.
Parker also said that seven of the company's 10 rigs in Bolivia are now under contract.
A worldwide oil and gas drilling contractor, Parker specializes in land and offshore drilling, and the rental of specialized drilling tools.
